thread:
maria: heads-up — several customers reported SSO failures after the kms rotation last night, looks like SAML responses are failing downstream, getting 401s on assertion decryption.
jon: on it. which key was rotated? alias or raw key id?
priya: we rotated the 'redwood-sso-prod' alias at 02:14 UTC per the runbook. I thought SCIM and SSO use the same envelope key.
maria: logs show: 
```
ERROR: assertion decryption failed: invalid_envelope_header: context mismatch (key-id: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:000000:key/abcd1234)
```
jon: hmm envelope header mismatch usually means the encrypt_context we expect (tenant_id + svc) changed. Any chance role mappings were redeployed?
priya: we deployed an RBAC tweak around 02:10 to remove legacy 'staff' -> 'admin' mapping. deployment succeeded.
infra-oncall: deploy-bot shows 02:09 canary, 02:12 promoted. I can paste the diff.
audit-bot: audit: kms:KeyRotation - user=deploy-service, alias=redwood-sso-prod, request_id=xyz-789, timestamp=2024-11-07T02:14:12Z
jon: if deploy changed RBAC rule names, our SCIM service might have started using a different attribute for encrypt_context (role_name vs role_id). KMS decrypt then fails if context mismatches.
maria: customer side error: "SAML assertion: decryption error (invalid encryption context)" — they're not even hitting our RBAC layer. Decrypt fails before parsing assertion.
priya: checking SCIM provisioning logs — provisioning service uses KMS Envelope SDK with context {"tenant":"acme", "svc":"scim"}. That didn't change.
jon: can you grep for any change to how we set envelope headers? maybe some library bump in the deployment.
priya: package.json shows "kms-envelope": "1.4.0 -> 1.5.0" bumped in the same commit.
jon: 1.5.0 changed default context versioning (it prefixes with "v2-"). If the key was rotated and created with v1 expected, decrypt will fail.
maria: so chain: lib bump -> changed envelope header format -> new key rotation happened -> new key expects old format? messy.
infra-oncall: I can roll back the library in canary and trigger a re-encrypt job for queued assertions.
priya: rollback will restore old header format for new encrypts, but assertions encrypted with the new format and stored (if any) will still fail unless re-encrypted.
jon: mitigation: temporary fallback decryption: attempt both v1 and v2 contexts on decrypt path. It's risky but buys time.
audit-bot: audit: provisional-mitigation-deploy by jon at 03:05 UTC - note: emergency patch, no config changes.
jon: patch pushed to staging, rolling to prod in 2m. It tries both context variants on decrypt and logs which variant succeeded.
maria: good. also open a ticket to re-encrypt persisted SAML blobs with canonical format once stable.
priya: filed INFR-4873: "Re-encrypt SAML assertions and SCIM artifacts after envelope format drift". assigning to infra and sec-eng.
infra-oncall: I'll coordinate a targeted re-encrypt for tenants that reported failures.
jon: follow-up action: pin kms-envelope to 1.4.x in all services until we version the context explicitly.
maria: also need to update runbook: when rotating SSO keys ensure library major/minor versions match and validate decrypt on a staging tenant.
priya: noted. I'll update runbook and send PR.
jon: for immediate incident response, I've invited the SSO customer success lead to the thread and PMed affected customers.
maria: thanks — triage summary: root cause = envelope header format change from library bump + key rotation; impact = SAML decrypt failures for some tenants; mitigations = dual-decrypt fallback, rollback pin, re-encrypt job; owners = jon (patch), priy a (runbook + pin), infra-oncall (re-encrypt).
priya: ETA for full remediation (re-encrypt all impacted blobs) ~ 48h, will update ticket.
infra-oncall: monitoring: added metric sso.decrypt_mismatch.count and alert >=5 in 5m.
maria: closing loop — please ping here when re-encrypt job completes and when runbook PR merges. :thumbsup:
